findings.title: Overly permissive policy: AdministratorAccess
findings.recommendation: Remove this policy or replace with least-privilege permissions. Action '*' and Resource '*' grants full access. This is an AWS-managed policy and cannot be edited: detach it and attach a customer-managed least-privilege policy instead.

findings.title: Trust policy: Any GitHub repository can assume this role
findings.description: The role trusts GitHub Actions OIDC without constraining the token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub claim (or every value is a wildcard), so workflows in any GitHub repository can assume it.
findings.recommendation: Add a StringEquals/StringLike condition on token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub limiting it to your repository and branch, e.g. repo:my-org/my-repo:ref:refs/heads/main.

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: mixed-star-inline
findings.recommendation: Remove this policy or replace with least-privilege permissions. Action '*' and Resource '*' grants full access.

findings.title: Trust policy: Any AWS account can assume this role
findings.description: The trust policy allows the AWS principal '*' without a condition on the caller's organization, account or ARN, so any principal in any AWS account can assume the role.
findings.recommendation: Replace '*' with specific account or role ARNs, or add a condition such as aws:PrincipalOrgID to restrict callers to your organization.

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: bucket-star-inline
findings.recommendation: Restrict permissions: use specific actions instead of service wildcards (e.g. s3:*), and scope resources to specific ARNs where possible.

findings.title: Console access without MFA
findings.description: The user has a console password but no MFA device, so a stolen or guessed password is enough to sign in.
findings.recommendation: Require this user to enrol an MFA device, or remove the console password.

findings.title: Unused iam permissions: CreateAccessKey, PassRole
findings.description: Principal has 2 unused permission(s) for iam. Only actions tracked by AWS Access Advisor are assessed.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused iam permissions from policies.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Create access keys for other users
findings.description: Can mint credentials for another, more privileged user.
findings.recommendation: Scope iam:CreateAccessKey to the principal's own user (${aws:username}).

metadata.rule_name: Create access keys for other users

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Pass a role to a new EC2 instance
findings.description: Can launch an instance with a privileged instance profile and read its credentials.
findings.recommendation: Scope iam:PassRole to specific role ARNs and add an iam:PassedToService condition.

metadata.rule_name: Pass a role to a new EC2 instance

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: power-notaction-inline
findings.recommendation: Replace NotAction with an explicit allow-list of the actions this principal needs: NotAction grants every action not listed, including future AWS actions.

findings.title: Unused kms permissions
findings.description: Principal has service unused permission(s) for kms.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused kms permissions from policies.

findings.title: Unused secretsmanager permissions
findings.description: Principal has service unused permission(s) for secretsmanager.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused secretsmanager permissions from policies.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Overwrite Lambda function code
findings.description: Can replace the code of an existing function and run as its role.
findings.recommendation: Scope lambda:UpdateFunctionCode to specific functions.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Update a Glue dev endpoint
findings.description: Can add an SSH key to an existing dev endpoint and use its role.
findings.recommendation: Remove glue:UpdateDevEndpoint or scope it to specific endpoints.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Run commands through SSM
findings.description: Can run commands on managed instances and use their instance roles.
findings.recommendation: Scope ssm:SendCommand to specific instances and documents.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Start SSM sessions
findings.description: Can open a shell on managed instances and use their instance roles.
findings.recommendation: Scope ssm:StartSession to specific instances.

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: deployers-read
findings.recommendation: Review and narrow permissions: prefer specific actions over wildcards and restrict resources to required ARNs.

findings.title: Unused s3 permissions: GetBucketPolicy, GetBucketTagging, GetBucketVersioning
findings.description: Principal has 3 unused permission(s) for s3. Only actions tracked by AWS Access Advisor are assessed.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused s3 permissions from policies.

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: mixed-resource-inline
findings.recommendation: Review and narrow permissions: prefer specific actions over wildcards and restrict resources to required ARNs.

findings.title: Overly permissive policy: passrole-runner-inline
findings.recommendation: Review and narrow permissions: prefer specific actions over wildcards and restrict resources to required ARNs.

findings.title: Privilege escalation path: Assume any role
findings.description: Can assume any role whose trust policy trusts this account.
findings.recommendation: Scope sts:AssumeRole to specific role ARNs.

findings.title: Principal has no policies attached
findings.recommendation: Attach appropriate policies or add inline policies if this principal should have access.
